title: Kenyan Goat Tagine
description: Richly spiced Kenyan goat tagine is a hearty and flavorful stew originating from East Africa.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the goat meat and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Add the onions, garlic, and ginger to the pot and cook until the onions are translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the browned goat meat back to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the tomatoes to the pot and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the goat meat is tender.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
